about: Shared cases for round 37, written by the browser simulation. The Windows app must give the same words.
label: List what moved in my data since I last closed Today
hint: Kept on this PC when you close Today, and never sent anywhere: for each ANDA its number, goal date, forecast date and a short fingerprint of its open item (never the item's words), and when it was kept. Turning this off removes what is kept, and Today keeps nothing for it.
off: Since you last looked is off. What this PC kept for it was removed.
on: Since you last looked is on. The next time you close Today is the first look kept.

items: Settings has a switch for Today's “Since you last looked” (beside Recent ANDAs). Turned off, Today does not list what moved and keeps nothing for it on this PC, and what was kept is removed.
